summary: Iteration 42 — Orrbbit iter42 user-reported bugs + approved changes. FRONTEND ONLY at 390x844 mobile + 1440x800 admin against the preview URL. ALL 6 REQUESTED FLOWS PASS with zero regressions. PRIMARY BUG VERIFY 1 (mode isolation) PASSED end-to-end: (a) server-side — with kauri switched to app_mode=professional via PUT /api/users/me/mode, POST /api/pings/generate?lat=-37.8136&lng=144.9631 returned {ping:null} on 20/20 consecutive calls; switched back to people and 30 additional calls returned 24 non-null pings (has_ping) proving the generator itself is healthy; (b) UI — after tapping mode-professional on radar home, ping-modal ([data-testid=ping-modal]) never appeared during a 50s watch window, and after a full page reload with intro_app_mode='professional' the mode persisted (localStorage + /auth/me both report professional) and ping-modal remained absent through an additional 20s watch. AppContext.tsx gates the poll on appMode==='people' (line 249) + clears activePing on switch to professional (line 157) + persists to AsyncStorage + calls PUT /users/me/mode; server /api/pings/generate returns {ping:null} at server.py:1403-1404. BUG VERIFY 2 (rounded photo card) PASSED: person/[id] primary photo now renders as a fitted rounded card — image 358x400 on a 390px viewport (16px inset each side, NOT full-bleed), container borderRadius=22px (rounded rectangle, NOT circular), objectFit=cover, 1/3 counter overlay top-left, 3-dot indicator at bottom of pager, 3 photos swipeable horizontally. 2-PHOTO MINIMUM PASSED: /edit-profile shows 'Photos (3/6)' header + 'Add at least 2 photos to complete your profile.' subline (no lingering 3-photo copy anywhere on the page); a freshly-registered user (POST /api/auth/register with date_of_birth=1996-01-01, accept_policies=true) hits GET /api/users/me/completion → checklist first entry {key:'photos', label:'Add at least 2 photos', done:false, required:true}, missing=['Add at least 2 photos','Write your bio (40+ characters)','Verify your email'] (exactly 3 items), message='Add at least 2 photos so people nearby can get a better sense of who you are.' — server-side minimum lowered as expected. CREDENTIAL LIFECYCLE (admin) PASSED: /control/verifications tab bar renders in the exact requested order — Pending (0) / Verified (13) / Annual Review Due (0) / Expiring Soon (1) / Expired (2) / More Info Required / Rejected (2) / All. Every Approved row shows the teal 'Complete Annual Review' button alongside Reject / Request More Info / Renew / Suspend. Clicking 'Complete Annual Review' on Rory — IT opens a 'Confirm: annual review' modal with body 'Rory — IT. The professional will be notified. This action is audited.', Cancel + teal 'Confirm decision' actions and a reviewer-note textarea; confirming updates the row to show 'Reviewed 2026-08-17 · Next review 2027-08-17' immediately below the 'Submitted 2026-08-05 · valid until 2028-07-12' line (12-month review cycle, real expiry precedence preserved). Note: the sample rory row has doc expiry 2028-07-12 which is > 12 months out, so next-review=2027-08-17 is the 12-month cycle (correct — cycle < expiry). SIDEBAR LOGO PASSED: from /control/audit-logs, clicking the header logo image navigates back to /control overview. REGRESSION PASSED: People radar loads (Melbourne CBD map, 58 nearby, radius 500m, extended-radius-note visible, all radar-blip-* testIDs present), Nearby list loads (Maya/Sarah/Olivia/Alex/Tom rows with avatars/vibes/distance/'Available now'/prompts), /privacy age filter intact ('Age range 18-65+', slider + expansion toggle), person full profile sections all render (About, Vibe Details, Looking For, Tags, About block with Lives in/From/Occupation/Education/Languages, Interests, You Both Like, About Me prompt, Joined Orrbbit July 2026, Let's Connect CTA), admin dashboard overview loads with KPIs and sidebar without error boundary. No red-screen errors observed. Final state: kauri restored to people mode + visible=true + radius=500 as instructed; one DEMO annual-review was completed on Rory (safe seeded data).

react_native_issues.issue: Non-blocking console warnings on every mobile screen: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — pre-existing across the app (Shell.tsx / ui.tsx / photo card styles), already flagged in iteration_41. Reference: no functional impact today; batch migrate before RN-Web major bump.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1403-1404 correctly returns {ping:null} for app_mode=='professional' BEFORE any candidate scan — defence-in-depth complements the AppContext client-side gate (AppContext.tsx:249 guards the poll, :157 clears activePing on switch).

person/[id].tsx photo pager: primary card renders at width=(screenW-32) with borderRadius:22 (measured 358x400 on 390px viewport, container BR=22px) — matches spec (inset, rounded, not circular, not full-bleed).
edit-profile.tsx + PhotoGrid + /api/users/me/completion consistently use the '2 photos' minimum (label, missing list, suggestions, message all updated) — no residual 3-photo copy found.

control/verifications.tsx tab set matches spec exactly: Pending / Verified / Annual Review Due / Expiring Soon / Expired / More Info Required / Rejected / All; 'Complete Annual Review' action shows on Approved rows and correctly updates Reviewed / Next review dates after confirm (12-month cycle, expiry precedence preserved).
Shell.tsx logo Pressable navigates to /control on click — verified from /control/audit-logs.

success_rate.backend: spot-checked (mode-isolation + completion endpoints) — 100% of 55 curl assertions passed
success_rate.frontend: 100% of the 6 requested flows verified end-to-end; only 1 pre-existing RN-Web deprecation warning surfaced

seed_data_creation: Registered one throwaway test user (test_iter42_<epoch>@example.com) solely to inspect /users/me/completion for a fresh account — never logged in via UI. Completed ONE demo annual review on rory@radar.intro.demo (Verified queue, first Approved row) — this is DEMO data and reversible via POST /api/demo/reset if needed. Kauri restored to app_mode=people + visible=true + radius=500 at end of run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL: https://nearby-connect-93.preview.emergentagent.com. Login response uses key 'access_token' (NOT 'token'). Kauri password: Intro123!. Mode switch endpoint: PUT /api/users/me/mode {app_mode:'people'|'professional'} (NOT PUT /api/users/me — that endpoint ignores app_mode silently). Playwright login shortcut: localStorage.setItem('auth_token', JSON.stringify(token)) THEN goto '/'; also set localStorage.intro_app_mode = JSON.stringify('people'|'professional'). Nearby list doesn't always contain Mia in the first viewport — tap any 'Name, age' row to reach person/[id]. On first switch to Professional mode a pro-disclaimer-modal (testID pro-disclaimer-modal) blocks the UI with 'I understand' / 'Go back' — accept before further interaction. Admin login: POST /api/control/auth/login → key 'token'; localStorage keys are control_token and control_admin_mode (both JSON-stringified). Confirm modal on 'Complete Annual Review' has button text 'Confirm decision' (teal). Ping generator is stochastic (~60-80% has-ping rate in people mode with kauri visible); absence in people mode within short window is not a failure — the pass criterion is 20/20 null in professional mode over ~50s + no ping-modal in UI.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Iter42 changes are correctly implemented server-side (server.py:1403-1404 professional-mode short-circuit) and client-side (AppContext.tsx appMode==='people' poll gate + activePing clear on switch + AsyncStorage persistence + PingModal early return). Only observation: initial demo Approved submissions display 'Submitted <date> · valid until <date>' (no Reviewed/Next-review line) because lifecycle_data is only populated after the first annual review — this matches the spec (dates appear only when lifecycle data exists) and was confirmed by completing one review and watching the row update in-place.
